comparison.objective: Clamp two aligned stacked boards with a one-hand bar clamp.
comparison.physical_skill: Position opposing jaws around a stack, drive a sliding ratchet jaw, establish force, and release the clamp.
comparison.success_condition: Pads have at most 0.5 mm gaps, clamping force is at least 20 N, alignment and placement tolerances hold, and the released assembly stays still for 1 second.
comparison.reason: It shares locking and force verification only generically; it tests external jaw placement and clamping, not recessed hex access, moving-socket reacquisition, or damping adjustment.
